question: In a certain fashion house, which has four sizes of a specific shirt, there is one-third as many small shirts as medium shirts, and 1/2 as many large shirts as small shirts. If there are as many X-large shirts as large shirts, what percent of the shirts in the store are medium?
explanation:
🔖Let, the parcent of medium shirts be M.
Then, the parcent of small shirts = M/3
The parcent of large shirts = (1/2) x M/3 = M/6
The parcent of X-large shirts = M/6
Now, M = 1 - (M/3 + M/6 + M/6) = 1- 2M/3
or, M + 2M/3 = 1
or, 5M/3 = 1
or, M = 3/5
So, M = (3/5) x 100% = 60%

question: 60% of the students of a college are male. 60% of the male in the college speak French and 40% of the students of the college speak French. What percent of the female in the college do not speak French?
explanation:
🔖Let the total number of students be 100. Then, the number of french speaking students is 40.
Now, the number of male students is 60% of 100 = 60.
Then, the number of female students is 100-60 = 40.
Then, the number of french speaking male student = 60% of 60 = 36
So, the number of french speaking female student = 40 - 36 = 4
Therefore the number of female students not speaking french = 36 ≡ 36%

question: Three athletes X, Y and Z start running around a circular track of length 60m from the same point simultaneously in the same direction at speeds of 3 m/s, 5 m/s, and 9 m/s respectively. After how long will they meet for the first time after they started running?
explanation:
🔖Time take by X to cover a circle = 60/3 = 20 sec
Time taken by Y to cover a circle = 60/5 = 12 sec
Time taken by Z to cover a circle = 60/9 sec
So every 20 sec, X will be at the starting point.
Every 12 secs Y will be at the starting point.
Every 60/9 sec, Z will be at the starting point.
Taking their LCM, we get 60. So every 60 sec, all three will be at the starting point.
All meet for the first time at the starting point after they start moving after 60 sec.

question: A rectangular field of 200m by 120m has two roads running along its center, one along the length and the other along the width. If the width of the roads is 5m, what is the area covered by the two roads?

Area along the width = 120 x 5 = 600

But, the central (5 x 5) or 25 sq. m. area of the roads has been counted twice.
So, the area of the two roads = 1600 - 25 = 1575 sq. m.

question: Among the 120 students of a class, numbered 1 to 120, all even numbered students opt for Bangla, whose numbers are divisible by 5 opt for English and those numbers are divisible by 7 opt for Math. How many opt for none of these three subjects?
explanation:
🔖Here,
Number of even numbered students, n(B) = 120/2 = 60
Number of numbers divisible by 5, n(E) = 120/5 = 24
Number of numbers divisible by 7, n(M) = 120/7 ≈17
Number of even numbers divisible by 5, n(BꓵE) = 24/2 = 12
Number of numbers divisible by both 5 & 7, n(EꓵM) = 3
Number of even numbers divisible by 7, n(BꓵM) = 17/2 ≈ 8
Number of even numbers divisible by both 5 & 7, n(BꓵEꓵM) = 1
Number of students opting for atleast one of the subjects = n(BUEUM)
n(BUEUM) = n(B) +n(E) + n(M) - n(BꓵE) - n(EꓵM) - n(BꓵM) + n(BꓵEꓵM)
= 60 + 24 + 17 - 12 - 3 - 8 + 1 = 79
Students opting for none of the subjects, n(BUEUM)' = 120 - n(BUEUM) = 120 - 79 = 41.
subject: গাণিতিক যুক্তি
